project_type: Next.js 16 web application with App Router (Tailwind CSS v4)
build_system: npm with Next.js 16.2.4 (Turbopack). AGENTS.md warns that Next.js 16 may have breaking changes from training data - check node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for current API patterns.
test_framework: No test framework currently set up. Will use Jest with React Testing Library for unit tests.
build_command: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && npm run build
test_command: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && npm run lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify production build succeeds. 2. Run npm run lint to verify no linting errors.
setup_instructions: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && npm install
environment_constraints: Node.js v22 available via nvm (must source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh first). OPEN_INTERNET network mode - can install packages and access external APIs. No Docker daemon needed. The Riot API key will be stored in .env.local (gitignored). Use a placeholder RIOT_API_KEY value for development.
contribution_requirements: Use responsive Tailwind CSS utility classes. Ensure Semantic HTML is used for all layout sections. API keys must never be exposed to client-side code - use Next.js Route Handlers (server-side) to proxy Riot API calls.
key_patterns: Next.js 16 App Router with file-based routing. Route Handlers use route.ts files with exported HTTP method functions (GET, POST). Params in route handlers are accessed via Promise (await params). Uses Tailwind CSS v4 with @import 'tailwindcss' in globals.css. Path alias @/* maps to project root. Uses Geist font family from next/font/google.
relevant_files: app/page.tsx - main page to replace with match history dashboard
app/layout.tsx - root layout with fonts and metadata
app/globals.css - Tailwind CSS v4 config and custom properties
next.config.ts - Next.js config (needs images.remotePatterns for champion icons)
tsconfig.json - TypeScript config with @/* path alias
directory_structure: Root: app/ (pages, layouts, route handlers), public/ (static assets). No src/ directory. Uses app router directly at project root level.
